647-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
647-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3800-4687-4702.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
3800-4687-4702.description:
Activate Splinter Twin by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

710-772-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
710-772-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2738-4556-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Blight Mound, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1742-5003-6798-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
1742-5003-6798-7848.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 three additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
1742-5003-6798-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

1090-2350-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-3899-5434-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5223-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-5223-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

1367-7012-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Sanar. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1367-7012-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

914-3036-7297.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-7297.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

2438-3755-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2438-3755-4871-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3215-5686-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2793-2981-5089-6459.description:
If Karn has exactly one loyalty counter on it, activate its first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus will be exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

1355-1978-2392.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
1355-1978-2392.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat

2034-4506-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4506-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

4444-5742-5743-6441.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4050-5544-6094.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and gaining 1 life.
Repeat.

864-1018-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
864-1018-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Skullwinder.
When Eternal Witness and Skullwinder enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1018-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

719-1308-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1170-3821-6062.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{W}{W}.
1170-3821-6062.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{W}.
Cast Shackles by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Shackles spell.
Activate Shackles by paying {2}{W}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2-1308-4659-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2290-3514-4613.notablePrerequisites: Karlov of the Ghost Council has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2290-3514-4613.description:
Activate Karlov of the Ghost Council using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Karlov of the Ghost Council triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1462-2812-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1462-2812-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Knight of Doves triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

413-751-1651-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {2}.
413-751-1651-3263.description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {1}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Blasting Station and Shrieking Drake, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger from step 3, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

232-3249-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {R}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

98-565-3634.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a Forest.
You control an Island.
98-565-3634.description:
Cast Submerge without paying its mana cost, targeting Venser.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Venser.
Put either Venser into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Venser's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Submerge to your hand.
Repeat.
